query: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber:'38.213'}) WITH DISTINCT sec OPTIONAL MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable) WITH sec,count(DISTINCT tbl) AS tableCount WITH collect({sec:sec,n:tableCount}) AS grouped,max(tableCount) AS maxCount UNWIND grouped AS g WITH g,maxCount WHERE g.n=maxCount RETURN g.sec.sectionId AS sectionId,g.sec.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,g.n AS tableCount
